_comment: MOTH v3.1 — operator-tunable config. All thresholds are conservative defaults.
_mode_b_note: Mode B (LONG — smart money ride): min annualized funding %. Smart money confirmed + funding elevated.
_mode_a_note: Mode A (SHORT — retail fade): min annualized funding %. No smart money, pure retail crowding.
_mode_b_persistence_note: Mode B: 1.5h — early entry, catches crowding while still building.
_mode_a_persistence_note: Mode A: 2h — enough to confirm it's not a single-tick spike.
_leaderboard_note: Min top-20 traders long an asset to trigger Mode B. Raise to 3 for stricter confirmation.
_leverage_note: Hard cap. Mode B uses median of top-5 traders, floor 2x. Mode A always 2x.
_margin_note: USD per position (20% of $200 budget). Adjust proportionally if budget changes.
_slots_note: Max concurrent positions. Can mix Mode A and Mode B.
_daily_loss_note: Halt new entries if daily realized loss hits this. 5% of $200 budget.
_drawdown_note: Halt new entries if account drops 15% from peak.
_consec_losses_note: Trigger 2h cooldown after this many consecutive losses.
_cooldown_note: Global cooldown after consecutive loss streak.
_per_asset_note: Per-ticker cooldown after a loss on that asset.
_max_entries_note: Daily entry limit. Conservative — these are patient holds, not scalps.
_mode_b_timeout_note: Alpha expiry — smart money thesis (event front-run / liquidation cascade) decays in 24-36h.
_mode_a_timeout_note: Retail FOMO crowding cycle. 48h catches the full unwind.
_weak_cut_note: Close flat positions (ROE between -5% and +2%) after this many hours. Cuts deadweight.
_phase1_note: Max ROE loss before force-close. Backed by native Hyperliquid SL at same threshold.
_decay_note: Mode B only. Close if current leaderboard_count drops below entry_count * this value.
